response.text:
I can do that, but I need you to confirm exactly what you want before I touch your mailbox.

Quick definitions (so we’re clear):
- Archive = remove the Inbox label so messages stay in All Mail and are searchable; reversible at any time.  
- Delete = move to Trash (recoverable for 30 days), then permanently removed after 30 days; permanent deletion after that is irreversible.

Please confirm all of the following (copy/edit one of the example confirmation lines or write your own):

1) Action: Archive or Delete?  
2) Exact target sender: noreply@transitalerts.net — is that correct, and do you want to include emails that only mention that address (e.g., in CC) or strictly From: that address?  
3) Scope (choose one or specify):  
   - All messages from that sender in your account  
   - Only messages in Inbox  
   - Only messages older than N days (e.g., 90 days)  
   - Only messages before YYYY-MM-DD  
   - Exclude starred or unread messages (optional)  
4) Do you want a preview first (I’ll list how many messages match and show up to 20 subject/date lines) before I perform the action? (Preview requires reading your mailbox and will be shown before any destructive step.)

Examples you can copy and send back:
- "Yes — Archive all messages From:noreply@transitalerts.net in Inbox older than 90 days. Preview first: yes."  
- "Yes — Delete all messages From:noreply@transitalerts.net across all labels before 2025-01-01. Preview first: no."  

I will not run anything until you confirm exactly as above.
